laws.rule: Every watercraft entering Montana must be inspected for aquatic invasive species (pest mussels and plants carried on boats) before it is launched on Montana waters, and must stop at any open Montana inspection station. Boats with ballast tanks or bladders, such as wakeboard boats, must be decontaminated first. Nonresident watercraft also need a Vessel AIS Prevention Pass before launching. Transporting aquatic invasive species, dead or alive, is illegal.
laws.penalty_signal: Pass: US$30 motorised, US$10 non-motorised (about A$43 and A$14 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040).

laws.rule: Everyone who fishes in Montana needs a fishing licence and an Angler AIS Prevention Pass, bought with the licence. There is no pass fee for youth 15 and under.
laws.penalty_signal: Angler pass: US$7.50 for nonresidents (about A$11 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040).

items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess, buy, use and transport up to 1 ounce (about 28 g) of usable marijuana, with separate limits for concentrates and edibles. A retail sale to an adult-use customer is capped at 1 ounce of flower, and flower may not exceed 35% total THC.

Consuming marijuana in a public place or on public transport such as trains and buses is not allowed, except where the Department of Revenue licenses it. Consuming it while driving, or as a passenger in the enclosed part of a moving vehicle, is not allowed. Smoking in a public place carries a civil fine of up to US$50 (about A$71 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040).
